summary: Yum! Brands completed the sale of Pizza Hut rights in mainland China to Yum China for $1.2 billion cash, amending the master license to remove Pizza Hut references, while retaining KFC and Taco Bell licensing with incentives tied to KFC sales growth over 12 years. Yum China guaranteed subsidiary YCCL's obligations. The deal, announced previously, closed August 7, 2026. Watch for future Taco Bell expansion plans and ongoing KFC royalty incentive mechanics.
